summary.one_line: The final Markdown set and pre-push protocol align; eight draft advisories record known limits without certifying game facts.

purpose.evidence: Read all 22 Markdown paths, including the new neutral-army explanation pair. Nine RU/EN page pairs have clear roles: landing, about/contributing, player/modding methods and format/placement explanations. The new title accurately identifies game deployment, not a predictor, and opens with scope. All 18 site pages remain explicitly draft, not certified articles.

structure.evidence: Compared 18 frontmatter records with CONTRIBUTING: two landing, four meta, six explanation, four how-to and two reference pages; types/statuses match in each RU/EN pair. The new placement explanation follows preparation, branch selection, footprint, row priority, group passes, retries, examples and evidence/limits. Older how-to draft gaps remain advisory.

specificity.evidence: For the new pair, checked conditional 10-to-3 split as 4+3+3, 2x2 anchors around obstacle (2,2), equal-row candidate order 8,4,6,10,2,7,3,5,9,1, and both observed coordinate tables against authorized research and capture data. The wording preserves that these are branch-specific checks, not one universal formation. Older installation/verification drafts remain general.

reproducibility.evidence: README and pre-push instructions still match package scripts and hook. New article gives a combat Start callback and labels screenshot frames as after Start, while coordinates were logged before turns. The exact WorkshopPolygon map is unpublished, so readers cannot reproduce the pictured battles; both drafts disclose that limit. I did not run the game or independently execute the disassembled code.

evidence.evidence: Checked new S1-S6 claims against the authorized research note, including late corrections for unreachable merging, world/local guard coordinates, CombatSize (not tier), deployment depth without field expansion, and equal-score sorting. Raw capture JSON matches both public coordinate tables; public observations.json records no predictor and correct capture timing; PNG SHA-256 values match. This review did not independently regenerate research, verify game binaries, or certify all claims. All 18 pages remain draft.

applicability.evidence: The new pair pins Heroes V Tribes of the East with Universe and the investigated EXE hash, separates game algorithm from predictor, limits its conclusions to checked branches, and says exact map/other modes/builds are not established. Existing player guides continue to distinguish original game, expansions, Universe and mod build requirements. No cross-version runtime test was performed.

translations.evidence: Checked all nine reciprocal RU/EN page pairs and matching content_type/status/faction. New army-placement pair preserves the same branch limits, S1-S6 checks, two coordinate tables, early-frame/Start distinction, unpublished-map caveat, and links. The getting-started pair adds corresponding links. 19 HTML pages and link checks passed per parent; I did not independently run translation tooling.

maintenance.evidence: CONTRIBUTING remains the article standard, and README/AGENTS point to it. The placement pair is linked in both nav sections and player starting pages; NOTICE states screenshot ownership limits. Its prepared JSON supplies coordinates and hashes without private raw logs. review:info now lists 22 Markdown paths, all covered here; any next content change needs a new exact-diff review.
